instruction: Apply yellow highlight to all italicized text while maintaining the italic formatting

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires highlighting all italic text with yellow background. Document has 21 italic runs. Evaluator checks all italic runs have yellow-ish highlight color and returns proportional score.

scoring_breakdown.0.0: No italic text is highlighted in yellow
scoring_breakdown.partial: Some italic text has yellow highlight (proportional)
scoring_breakdown.1.0: All italic text has yellow highlight

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts state: Iterates through all paragraphs and runs, identifies all italic runs (docs.py:32-35)

Correct yellow highlight verification: Checks 'run.font.highlight_color == WD_COLOR_INDEX.YELLOW' (line 38) and 'run.font.highlight_color == 7' (line 41), which are exact equality checks for yellow color
Complete coverage: Checks ALL italic text in document and returns proportional score (yellow_italic_count / italic_count)
Proper postconfig: Saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure latest state is captured
Minor note: RGB fallback (lines 44-54) uses fill.fore_color which is technically different from highlight_color, but serves as reasonable fallback for edge cases
